newsitem.title: USA: JMC Group, USBA Holdings deal off.
newsitem.headline: JMC Group, USBA Holdings deal off.

text.p: JMC Group Inc said it had terminated its agreement to effect a combination with USBA Holdings Ltd of Atlanta.
The company said in a statement late on Monday that the decision followed a special meeting of the JMCG Board to review the status of the proposed combination.
The agreement, which was approved by the JMCG Board on May 20, had not been put to a vote of JMCG's stockholders.
At its meeting, the JMCG board concluded that "based upon information now available to the board, the proposed combination is not in the best interests of JMCG's stockholders," the statement said.

In a related development, J.C. Bradford & Co, which was retained by JMCG to render a fairness opinion with respect to the proposed combination, has withdrawn its fairness opinion originally delivered to the JMCG Board on May 20.
